facts.business: Latteys Industries Limited manufactures pumps, motors, and solar water-pumping systems for agriculture, water management, and renewable energy applications.

segments.name: Single segment (pumps, motors, solar pumping systems)

key_risks: Policy and Subsidy Risk: Solar pumping demand is influenced by government schemes, subsidy structures and state-level implementation policies. Changes in such policies may affect market demand or project timelines.
Tender Margin Risk: Highly competitive tendering may place pressure on selling prices and margins.

Execution Risk: Large institutional and government projects may involve stringent timelines, documentation and performance requirements. Delays in approvals, site readiness or customer-side processes may affect project execution and working capital.
Receivable Risk: Project-based business may result in longer collection cycles.

Product Liability and Warranty Risk: Pumps and motors are performance-oriented products. Product quality, installation conditions, operating environment and maintenance can influence field performance.
Raw Material Risk: Volatility in the prices of metals, electrical components and other manufacturing inputs can affect margins.
